exposure: 3D MRI modeling to guide uterine incision
Use of 3D MRI modeling to guide uterine incision
cohort: 134 women with singleton pregnancies complicated by placenta previa who delivered by cesarean
finding: Uterine incision guided by a 3D MRI model resulted in less intraoperative blood loss, shorter operative times, and fewer transfusions during cesarean delivery in women with placenta previa.
